name: Topic row
summary: One row of a forum or community topic list: avatar, title with its category tag, a two-line plain-text excerpt and a meta row of author, likes, replies and time. Ships as a web component and as a class layer (lib/topic-row.css) a host such as a Discourse theme applies to its own markup.
highlights: Avatar, title, category tag, two-line excerpt, meta row
Web component, or a class layer for Discourse
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-topic-row>, plus the same CSS as a class layer. The row is a 40px <aha-avatar>, then the title (a link, 16/600 ink) with the category <aha-tag> beside it, the excerpt (14/400 secondary, plain text, clamped to two lines) and a meta row in tertiary: author, likes, replies and time. 16px vertical padding and a 1px --aha-border-secondary divider; the last row drops it. States: unread is the rest look (title SemiBold), `read` drops the title to Regular, `pinned` puts a pin icon inside the title link, before its text, hover tints the row --aha-bg-hover. Two ways in: a page that builds its own list uses the element; a host that renders its own row markup (Discourse, whose keyboard navigation, click tracking and unread state hang off its own tr.topic-list-item and a.raw-topic-link) links lib/topic-row.css and adds the aha-topic-row classes to that markup. The Discourse tab maps each Discourse class to its DS class. The element and the file share one stylesheet (lib/topic-row-css.js), so they cannot drift. The category slot uses <aha-tag> until the category chip lands.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. React and Vue pass attributes to the custom element. The class layer lib/topic-row.css is generated from the element's own stylesheet, so a Discourse theme and the element render the same row.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: avatar + main column · padding 16 top and bottom, 16 at each side · divider 1px border-secondary #F1F1F1, none on the last row

spec.label: Avatar
spec.value: 40px <aha-avatar>, 12px gap to the text, aligned to the top

spec.label: Title
spec.value: 16px / 1.5 · SemiBold 600 · text-default #1A1A1A · a link, underline on hover, 2px border-focus ring on keyboard focus

spec.label: Category
spec.value: <aha-tag> after the title, links to the category (the category chip replaces it when it ships)

spec.label: Excerpt
spec.value: 14px / 1.5 · Regular 400 · text-secondary #4A4A4A · plain text, two lines then an ellipsis · 4px under the title

spec.label: Meta
spec.value: 14px / 1.5 · text-tertiary #616161 · author, likes (heart), replies (chat), time · 16px between items · 8px under the excerpt

spec.label: Pinned
spec.value: `pinned` → system-push-pin 16px in icon-default inside the title link before its text, named Pinned

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: row background bg-hover #F7F7F7 on pointer devices, motion-fast ease-out

props.name: topic-title
props.desc: The topic title, rendered as text in the title link

props.name: href
props.desc: Where the title links (the topic, or its first unread post)

props.name: author
props.desc: The topic starter's name: the first meta item and the avatar's initials

props.name: avatar-src
props.desc: Avatar photo URL; initials of `author` when absent

props.name: category
props.desc: Category name shown as a tag after the title; omit for no tag

props.name: category-href
props.desc: Makes the category tag a link

props.name: excerpt
props.desc: Plain text, set as text (never parsed as HTML), clamped to two lines. Strip HTML and BBCode such as [poll]…[/poll] before passing it

props.name: likes
props.desc: Like count with a heart icon; omit to hide

props.name: replies
props.desc: Reply count with a chat icon; omit to hide

props.name: read
props.desc: The reader has opened this topic: the title drops to Regular

props.name: pinned
props.desc: Shows the pin icon inside the title link, before its text

whenToUse.when: a list of forum or community topics: latest, a category, search results that are topics
the host renders its own row markup and cannot swap it for an element (a Discourse theme)
uniform rows of anything else (decks, participants) with a title and a short description
multi-column records to sort or compare

opinion.note: Pass the excerpt as plain text: the row never renders markup, so BBCode left in it shows as raw text. Keep the title the only link besides the category tag; the row itself is not a link. In Discourse use the class layer on Discourse's own markup (see the Discourse tab) so keyboard navigation, click tracking and unread state keep working.
opinion.dsv3: EXTENSION — DS V3 has no forum topic row. Built from the List row conventions (avatar, title and description meta, row dividers, hover bg-hover) at forum density: a 40px avatar, 16px title, a two-line excerpt and a meta row, all on --aha-* tokens, reusing <aha-avatar>, <aha-tag> and registry icons.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the rendered element (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe row carries every slot, so title, excerpt, meta, divider and padding all render; the measure also proves a real <aha-avatar> at 40px is nested.
